mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that constrains credit availability and reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and labor market resilience, driving positive equity returns through sustained corporate revenue growth over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in PAYEMS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 315) reflects central bank policy inertia that elevates real interest rate risk, suppressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 315.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing output growth, supporting corporate profit expansion and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates tight labor market conditions that amplify consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with broader economic momentum and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth fails to yield positive 60-day returns in more than 65% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 units, it signals economic overheating that triggers central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1300.
